build_evaluator_instance: build an Evaluator instance to evaluate metrics on tracking datasets
run_evaluate_datasets: run the Evaluator.evaluate method to evaluate metrics across multiple datasets and trackers
run_evaluate_tracker: run the Evaluator.evaluate_tracker method to evaluate a single tracker across all sequences
run_eval_sequence: run the eval_sequence function to evaluate a single sequence against a tracker and metrics
run_combine_classes: run the class and super-category combination logic in evaluate_tracker to aggregate results
